records.notes: The site showed only an under construction page on 2026-10-08: no programs, dates, contacts or address. Name and kind come from the IRS batch. Held back (no summary, categories or audience) until a working site or a tier 2 check shows what the group does.

records.name: Philly Voice For Change
records.summary: Works to keep Philadelphia families together when poverty, substance use or contact with public systems threatens to split them apart. The team includes social workers, lawyers, peer mentors and people who have been through it themselves.
records.what_you_do: Families and partners can send a referral or reach out through the contact form. The site does not describe a volunteer schedule.

first_step.how: Send a referral or ask about getting involved through the contact form on phillyvoiceforchange.org, or sign up for their event emails
first_step.basis: The site invites people to get involved and sign up for updates, but it does not describe a volunteer or join process.

records.notes: IRS name is Philly Voice; the site uses Philly Voice For Change. The site lists no dated events. Its events and news page returned a 404 on 2026-10-08. The 2024 footer is not counted as evidence, so status is probably_active because the site works but shows no dates. Closest tags used: mentoring and kids-youth-mentoring, since this is a family support service. Donations accepted by CashApp and a Square link. Batch PO box not used.

records.name: Police Transparency Project
records.summary: Gathers court dockets, case files and affidavits to document police and prosecutor misconduct in Philadelphia, and shares the records with the public. It also pushes for policy and law changes.
records.what_you_do: Search or add to the public database of misconduct records, join the mailing list, or use the volunteer page to ask how to help.

first_step.how: Join the mailing list at thepolicetransparencyproject.com, or use the Volunteer page to ask how to help
first_step.basis: The volunteer page exists but gives no details, so the way in is unclear.

records.notes: Website found through the GuideStar profile after the batch gave only the group name. Newest dated item is a report titled Audits of Complaints Against PPD Report 2022 (year in the title, no month), so status is dormant, even though the site calls its database ongoing. No dated news, events or meetings are listed. Mailing address is a PO box (PO Box 2656, Philadelphia 19130), with no meeting place. The site says it is not affiliated with any other organization. No partisan activity seen. Used one of the two searches.

records.name: Real Life International Ministries
records.summary: A faith-based ministry that gives one-on-one help with food, housing, jobs, health, legal questions and addiction, and offers life skills and leadership training.
records.what_you_do: Call, email or use the contact page to describe what you need. The ministry arranges help one on one and offers training for people who want to lead a ministry.

first_step.how: Call (215) 792-3298 or use the Contact Us page on rlimnow.org to ask for one-on-one help
first_step.basis: Help is arranged one on one after you reach out. The site does not describe worship times or an intake process.

records.notes: Site footer shows 2018, which is not counted as evidence. No dated events, worship times or volunteer openings on the site, so status is probably_active only because the site works. Batch website was WWW.RLIMNOW.ORG. Donation and partner forms are not recorded. Linked sister sites checked and dropped: Real Life CDC (same PO box and phone, 2018 footer, contact form only) and WorkDatWord (a content arm with 2017 and 2018 posts, no group to join).

records.name: Restore Salon Services
records.summary: Stylists give free haircuts and styling to people who cannot get to a salon because of illness, disability or displacement, including at hospitals, rehab centers and at home.
records.what_you_do: Clients ask for a visit through the request form. Helpers and sponsors can start from the Join Our Village page, which the site links to but does not describe in detail.

schedule.text: Free services at the Hospital of the University of Pennsylvania every Monday, at Jefferson Moss-Magee Rehabilitation on the third Sunday of each month, and in weekly three-hour sessions at Ronald McDonald House Charities in Philadelphia

first_step.how: If you need a visit, use the Join the Circle of Care form on restoresalonservices.org. To help, start with the Join Our Village page.
first_step.basis: Anyone who needs a visit can sign up through a public form. Volunteer steps are not described on the site.

records.notes: Site says the organization was established in 2020 and reports over 4,000 free services. Schedule and partner timing are undated (the site says the Jefferson partnership is in its third year), so no dated sign of life was found. No phone number or street address is published. Site says service is for people with a medical condition, a disability or displacement. A TikTok icon on the site links to a Twitter address, so it is not recorded.

records.name: RISE Philadelphia
records.summary: Online tutoring for K-12 students in Philadelphia and South Jersey, paired one on one with graduate student tutors. Also offers college application help for high school students.
records.what_you_do: Graduate students tutor students one on one, online. Families sign up with the participation form, and tutors apply through the tutor interest inquiry.

first_step.how: Families: use the I need a tutor option on risephiladelphia.com to sign the participation form. Tutors: use the I want to tutor button to send an interest inquiry.
first_step.basis: Families and tutors each have a public sign-up form. The site says the team will reach out up to three times to make a pairing, and does not describe screening.

records.notes: Newest dated post is Summer Reading Programs 2026, dated Aug 14. The year comes from the post title, since the date beside it has no year. Other posts from March to September show no year. Several posts from late 2025 are dated with a year. Cost not stated on the site. Site says tutors are graduate students, so a newcomer may not qualify to tutor. Footer shows 2022 and is not counted.

records.name: Serra Club of Philadelphia
records.summary: A Catholic club that works to encourage vocations to the priesthood and religious life, and helps members listen for their own calling. Meetings feature speakers on vocations.
records.what_you_do: Attend a Zoom meeting as a guest of a member, or come to one of the quarterly meetings that are open to anyone. The club's past speaker videos and vocation resources are on the site.

schedule.text: Zoom meetings on the third Tuesday of each month. The October meeting was listed for Tuesday, October 20, 12:30 PM.

first_step.how: Visit the JOIN NOW page on serraclubphilly.org to sign up, or attend one of the quarterly Zoom meetings that are open to anyone
first_step.basis: The site says new members are welcome, links to a join page, and opens one meeting each quarter to anyone.

records.notes: IRS batch name is Serra International, the national parent. The Philadelphia club's own site is serraclubphilly.org, so it is recorded under its local name. Dated items on the site: an October Zoom meeting on Tuesday, October 20 with no year written, and a September meeting with no year. The 2026 footer is not counted, so no year-stamped sign of life was found. Other dates on the site are historical (1988, 2015). Officer email addresses are on the site and are not recorded. Closest interest tag used for vocations promotion; no exact tag exists. Batch address (222 N 17th St) is not on the site and is not recorded.

records.name: She Is U
records.summary: Support for people who have survived domestic violence, sexual abuse or sexual assault. Programs include transitional housing, transportation help, bereavement support, a family bonding program and a scholarship for survivors.
records.what_you_do: Survivors can use the programs listed on the site. Volunteers can start from the Volunteer button, and donors can give through the site's Givebutter page.

first_step.how: Survivors: ask through the contact page on sheisu.org, which is the only route listed. Volunteers: use the Volunteer button on the same site. Scholarship: fill in the Survivors Educational Scholarship form linked there.
first_step.basis: The site has a volunteer button and a scholarship form, but no phone, email, intake steps or volunteer roles.

records.notes: The only year on the site is a 2024 footer, which is not counted. No phone, email or street address on the site, and no crisis line is listed. The site does not say which areas it serves. Closest tags used: violence_prevention and housing_help. survivor_support is not used because the support-recovery family is for support groups only, and this is a services group.

records.name: Solewell Foundation
records.notes: The site (which calls itself The Sole Well Foundation) gives grants and scholarships to single-parent families in PA, DE, NY and NJ, with 2027 targets and no dated events. It publishes no way for a family to apply and no volunteer roles beyond a contact page and newsletter, so it is hidden as a private grant and scholarship foundation. The 2026 footer is not counted. Revisit if it publishes an application or a volunteer path.

records.name: Steps to New Horizons
records.summary: Free money skills workshops and coaching for immigrants, newcomers, young adults and people going through a loss or another big change in life.
records.what_you_do: Join a workshop such as Financial Foundations for Newcomers, or ask about coaching through the contact page. Donors can give on the site or through workplace giving.

cost.text: Workshops and programs are free to participants

first_step.how: Use the contact page on stnhorizons.com or the Subscribe for Updates form to ask about the next Financial Foundations for Newcomers workshop
first_step.basis: Newcomer workshops are free and open to the public, but the site does not describe how to enroll.

records.notes: The events menu leads to a page with no dated events, so status rests on the working site. The footer range 2025 to 2026 is not counted. Enrollment steps are not described. Phone is a 302 number as published. Legal name in the IRS batch: Steps to New Horizons Corp.
